title: Sinkhole in Xaythany leaves four missing
detail: A large sinkhole opened in Thongmang village; four people were missing and presumed dead, and the search was ended on 15 Jan after the Department of Geology and Minerals said the ground was highly unstable. Authorities pledged an investigation into the cause.
attribution: Department of Geology and Minerals and Xaythany District Administration, via The Nation

title: January road toll: 113 dead in 801 crashes
detail: The Traffic Police Department reported 801 road accidents in January 2026 with 113 deaths and 1,149 injuries; Vientiane Capital had the most (128 crashes, 27 deaths).
attribution: Traffic Police Department, Ministry of Public Security, via Laotian Times

title: Nearly 2,800 arrested in Golden Triangle SEZ since 2023, officials say
detail: At a Lao-Chinese security meeting, officials said nearly 2,800 suspects of 27 nationalities had been arrested in the Golden Triangle SEZ since 2023, plus 396 in 18 operations elsewhere in Bokeo; the GTSEZ police unit has been under direct Ministry of Public Security supervision since March 2023.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security officials, via Laotian Times

title: UXO: 7 casualties in two 2026 incidents so far
detail: Bernama reported 2 UXO incidents with 7 casualties so far in 2026 (25 casualties in 15 accidents in 2025), with President Thongloun Sisoulith urging faster clearance; a 113 kg bomb was removed in Huay Pan village, Luang Prabang, on 7 Jan.
attribution: Lao officials incl. President Thongloun Sisoulith, via Bernama

title: Bank of Lao PDR tightens offshore account rules
detail: BOL Decision No. 251/BOL requires prior central bank approval for most Lao residents opening offshore bank accounts, with account activity reportable to the BOL on request.
attribution: Bank of the Lao PDR decision, summarised by VDB Loi

title: PM2.5 exceeds 100 µg/m3 in several provinces
detail: The Ministry of Agriculture and Environment reported PM2.5 of 123 µg/m3 in Champasak and above 100 µg/m3 in Luang Prabang, Salavan and Attapeu (standard 50), and called for tighter burning controls and faster fire detection.
attribution: Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, via Xinhua

title: 16,000+ fire hotspots; AQI over 200 in the north
detail: The Ministry of Agriculture and Environment reported 16,395 hotspots in Q1 2026 (895 on 1 Apr alone) with AQI above 200 in Bokeo, Oudomxay and Luang Prabang, and urged masks and avoiding outdoor exercise.
attribution: Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, via Laotian Times

title: Overnight Pakse-Vientiane bus overturns, 8 dead
detail: An overnight bus from Pakse to Vientiane carrying 48 people overturned on a curve near Nam Duea village at about 04:20; authorities blamed wet roads and speeding. Eight died, including a foreigner, and 35 were injured.
attribution: Bolikhamxay provincial authorities, via Laotian Times

title: EDL schedules three days of daytime outages in Vientiane
detail: Electricité du Laos cut power for 5-9 hours on 24-26 April in Nongbone, Chanthabouly's Phontong area and Sibounhueang and Hongkaikeo villages for equipment installation and relocation of 18 poles for road works.
attribution: Laotian Times

title: APG follow-up keeps Laos partially compliant on higher-risk countries
detail: The Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering published Laos' 2nd enhanced follow-up report: Recommendation 19 stays Partially Compliant despite progress, with 16 of 40 FATF Recommendations rated C/LC.
attribution: APG follow-up report

title: 230 detained in Bokeo call-centre scam raids
detail: Bokeo provincial police said operations on 4-11 May in Houayxay (71) and Tonpheung (159) districts detained 230 suspects, including 106 Lao, 62 Chinese, 52 Myanmar, 5 Philippine, 4 Malaysian and 1 Indonesian nationals.
attribution: Bokeo Provincial Public Security Office, via KPL

title: 10.4 million meth pills and 1.2 t crystal meth seized in Vientiane
detail: Xaythany police said coordinated pre-dawn raids across Xaythany, Hadxaifong and Naxaythong districts seized 10.4 million methamphetamine pills, 1,235 kg crystal meth and 6.5 kg heroin, arresting five suspects.
attribution: Xaythany District Police, via Laotian Times

title: 135 detained in Boten SEZ scam operation
detail: Police detained 135 suspects in an operation in the Boten Special Economic Zone on the China border, part of a July-wide crackdown in which the Ministry of Public Security reported 1,044 detentions.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security, via Laotian Times

title: Laos reports 4,025 drug arrests in first half of 2026
detail: Prime Minister Sonexay Siphandone told the National Assembly that authorities handled 1,786 drug cases and arrested 4,025 suspects in H1 2026; reported seizures included 1.5 tonnes of meth tablets and 500 kg crystal meth in Vientiane Province in April and 300 kg crystal meth in Khammouane in July.
agency: Lao Government / Ministry of Public Security
attribution: Prime Minister Sonexay Siphandone (National Assembly report), via Laotian Times

title: 122 foreigners arrested in Sisattanak scam raid
detail: Vientiane police and immigration raided houses in Sisattanak district, detaining 122 people including 34 Chinese, 26 Brazilians and 19 Malaysians; the report lists further arrests of 28-174 people in operations on 3-8 July including at Boten and in Champasak.
attribution: Vientiane Capital Police, via Laotian Times

title: Public Security order bars landlords and hotels from hosting scam operations
detail: A Ministry of Public Security order prohibits individuals, businesses, hotels and landlords from providing premises or support to scam or illegal gambling operations, with fines, confiscated deposits and prosecution for violators and sanctions for officials who assist; it notes 4,482 cybercrime arrests in H1 2026.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security, via Laotian Times

title: Week-long heavy rain warning for eight provinces
detail: The Department of Meteorology and Hydrology warned of heavy to very heavy rain nationwide with risk of flash floods and landslides, singling out Phongsaly, Xieng Khuang, Xaysomboun, Bolikhamxay, Khammuan, Savannakhet, Champasak and Attapeu; a Savannakhet tributary was reported above its 8 m warning level.
attribution: Department of Meteorology and Hydrology (Ministry of Agriculture and Environment), via Xinhua

title: 261 detained in Thatluang Lake SEZ raid
detail: Vientiane police detained 261 suspects of seven nationalities (153 Chinese, 61 Vietnamese, 36 Thai and others) over an alleged telecom-fraud and online gambling operation in the Thatluang Lake SEZ; the outlet counted 550+ detentions in August.
attribution: Vientiane Capital Police, via Laotian Times

title: Flood watch as Mekong nears warning levels
detail: DMH reported the Mekong at 11.11 m at Vientiane Km4 (warning 11.50 m), 12.92 m at Thakhek (warning 13 m), 10.82 m at Pakse, and the Xe Don at Souvannakhili at 10.28 m, above its 10 m warning level.
attribution: Department of Meteorology and Hydrology, via KPL

title: Xe Lanong 1 dam to release water; Nam Theun 2 halts discharge
detail: Savannakhet authorities said Xe Lanong 1 hydropower dam would start releasing water from 11 Aug as inflows were forecast to rise from ~650 to up to 4,000 m3/s, and told nine downstream districts to warn residents; Nam Theun 2 Power Company said it suspended generation and releases into the Xe Bangfai from 7 Aug.
attribution: Savannakhet Provincial Administration and Nam Theun 2 Power Company, via The Star

title: Lao-Thai border checkpoints post sharp H1 revenue growth
detail: Lao Customs reported H1 2026 revenue of LAK 1.79 trillion at the 2nd Lao-Thai Friendship Bridge and LAK 996 billion at Vangtao (up 85%), with Lalai up 855% and 110,000+ travellers through the new 5th bridge, reflecting heavier cross-border trade.
attribution: Laotian Times

title: 1.76 tonnes of suspected ivory seized in Pakkading
detail: Bolikhamxay authorities detained 11 foreign nationals and seized about 1,755.6 kg of items resembling elephant ivory and two carcasses resembling black panthers, and said they were tracing the wider network.
attribution: Bolikhamxay provincial authorities, via The Star

title: Floods affect more than 10,000 in Savannakhet
detail: Flooding hit at least 11 villages in Phin and Sepone districts, affecting more than 10,000 people, with three temporary shelters opened; the Mekong at Pakse reached 11.52 m on 19 Aug, above the 11 m alert level, and flash floods were reported in Sekong and Nan district of Luang Prabang.
attribution: Lao local authorities, via Khaosod English

title: Dengue cases reach 4,371 nationwide
detail: KPL reported 4,371 cumulative dengue cases as of 24 Aug with no deaths; Vientiane Capital had the most (706), followed by Sekong (530), Oudomxay and Vientiane Province (459 each) and Khammouane (424).
attribution: Lao health authorities, via KPL

title: Public Security minister orders nationwide push after SIM-box raid
detail: After a 26 Aug raid in Lakhin and Houayhom villages, Sikhottabong district, seizing laptops, SIM boxes and transmission equipment (2 arrested), Minister of Public Security Lt Gen Vanthong Kongmany ordered intensified suppression of hidden cybercrime and online gambling nationwide.
attribution: Minister of Public Security Vanthong Kongmany, via KPL

title: Floods cut Route 13 North to Boten and leave 3,800+ Oudomxay homes without power
detail: Flooding and landslides on 28-29 August closed National Route 13 North from the Oudomxay border to Boten, hit 34 villages in Luang Namtha and 74 in Oudomxay, where at least 3,817 households lost power; repair crews were slowed by blocked roads.
agency: Provincial authorities / Department of Public Works and Transport
attribution: Laotian Times

title: Laos tallies 6,200+ cybercrime arrests in eight months
detail: Laotian Times counted at least 6,200 cybercrime suspects arrested Jan-Aug 2026 from 25+ nationalities, including 139 at two Xaysettha buildings on 31 Aug and 47 in Paklay district, Xayaboury, with Chinese nationals the largest group in most raids.
attribution: Laotian Times compilation of Lao police reports

title: OFAC designates Xinbi Guarantee, listed with Laos location
detail: OFAC designated the Xinbi Guarantee online marketplace as a transnational criminal organization, listing Burma, Thailand and Laos as locations; Treasury said it processed the equivalent of over USD 24 billion serving scam and laundering networks.
attribution: US Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control

title: Suspected rhino horn and ivory seized in Luang Prabang
detail: Luang Prabang's Natural Resources and Environment Inspection Division seized 28 kg of suspected rhinoceros horn, carved ivory, bile and wildlife-based medicines in Sanghalok village and detained a foreign man.
agency: Luang Prabang Natural Resources and Environment Inspection Division
attribution: Luang Prabang Provincial Natural Resources and Environment Inspection Division, via Laotian Times

title: 13 held in Vientiane raids; guns and meth found
detail: A Ministry of Public Security task force raided rentals in Chanthabouly and Hadxaifong districts, arresting 12 Chinese nationals and one Lao woman and seizing phones, computers, two handguns with ammunition and 1,494 suspected meth pills.
attribution: Ministry of Public Security task force, via KPL

title: 129 Thai nationals handed over after Vientiane and Champasak raids
detail: Following raids including 41 foreigners at Vientiane hotels on 16 Sep and 23 in Bachiang Chaleunsouk, Champasak on 18 Sep, 129 Thai nationals were handed to Thai authorities at the First Lao-Thai Friendship Bridge on 20 Sep.
attribution: Lao police, via Laotian Times

title: Laos-Thailand seminar on laundering tied to scam centres
detail: Lao agencies, the Thai embassy and UNODC met in Laos on preventing laundering linked to scam centres, covering urgent asset freezes, mule accounts and crypto misuse; Laos aims to complete measures by January 2027.
attribution: Seminar participants incl. Lao authorities and UNODC, via The Nation
